Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. ##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.

Return JSON with:

- entity_type: what this company is, judged from this window alone. One of: manufacturer (makes its own branded products), co_packer (makes products for other brands: contract manufacturing, private label, co-packing, filling, bottling), both, marketplace (a platform listing products from many sellers), investor (a private equity fund or financial holding whose portfolio companies operate independently; an industrial group or parent company that owns operating brands, factories or subsidiaries making products is a manufacturer, and its subsidiaries' products are its products), distributor (resells other manufacturers' products), other. If this window has no signal about entity type, choose other.
- products: each product type this company makes or can make, as a short English name (2 to 5 words, no brand names, no sizes), with a quote copied exactly from the text that names it, and storage: frozen, refrigerated or shelf_stable only if a storage word (frozen, refrigerated, chilled, fresh, shelf-stable, ambient, or equivalents in the site's language) appears with that product, otherwise null.
- capabilities: manufacturing or packaging services offered (for example contract manufacturing, private label, hot fill, retort, aseptic filling, canning, blending, pouch filling), each with an exact quote.
- brands: brand names that belong to this company.
- site_language: the main language of the text (ISO 639-1 code).
- summary: one sentence on what the company is and does.

Rules:
- Products listed on a marketplace, sold by a distributor, or made by an investor's portfolio companies are not this company's products; leave products empty and set entity_type accordingly.
- A capability sentence such as "we fill beverages" is not a product unless the text names the product type (for example "we fill energy drinks and kombucha" names two products).
- Copy every quote exactly as written in the text, including its original language. Do not translate or paraphrase quotes. Product names are in English even when the quote is not.
- Do not invent products from a company name, a page title or an image caption alone unless it plainly names a product type.
- Keep one entry per product type; list a product once even if it appears many times.

History | Johnvince Foods | Canada
##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.
In addition to domestic distribution, Johnvince Foods, out of its current 1,000,000 sq. ft. flagship facility, has been exporting and sourcing globally for decades, bringing the best products from around the world to our valued customers and consumers.

##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.

##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.

Site Web de PLANTERS® Canada
La marque PLANTERS® est une marque emblématique de cacahuètes et de snacks depuis 1916. Elle domine la catégorie en n'utilisant que les meilleurs ingrédients naturels pour offrir le goût et la qualité dont les gens raffolent. Des cacahuètes salées classiques aux mélanges inventifs, la marque PLANTERS® allie héritage et esprit ludique pour rester un favori des familles depuis des générations.

Nous restons fièrement une entreprise familiale, avec une culture qui valorise le travail d'équipe, la responsabilité et la célébration de nos victoires en tant qu'équipe. L'innovation.
### Rapide, flexible,
savoureux.
Quand l'intelligence rencontre l'agilité.Chez Johnvince, l'innovation est notre méthode de travail. Qu'il s'agisse de concepts meilleurs pour la santé ou de nouvelles idées audacieuses en matière d'arômes, nous collaborons avec nos partenaires pour créer le prochain grand snack.
Piliers de l'innovation
### Mieux pour vous
& Fonctionnel
Des en-cas utiles - protéines, fibres, options à base de plantes, probiotiques et ingrédients fonctionnels qui favorisent le bien-être sans compromettre le goût.
### Saveurs du monde et inspiration culturelle
Nous nous inspirons du large éventail de saveurs que les gens aiment aujourd'hui - des classiques réconfortants, des profils audacieux et des idées fraîches - pour créer des expériences d'en-cas qui se sentent invitantes, équilibrées et excitantes.
### Formats pratiques et portables
Le grignotage en toute simplicité. Des formats à portions contrôlées, refermables et à emporter, conçus pour s'adapter aux modes de vie actifs et offrir facilité, flexibilité et praticité au quotidien.
### Indulgence permise
Équilibrer le plaisir avec des choix réfléchis - des friandises raffinées qui offrent un goût exquis avec des ingrédients accessibles, et des formats qui répondent aux attentes évolutives des consommateurs d'aujourd'hui en matière d'en-cas.
Notre processus
Le laboratoire d'innovation Johnvince
Le Johnvince Snack Innovation Lab est au cœur de notre processus d'innovation. C'est là que convergent les connaissances des consommateurs, la science alimentaire et la créativité.
* **Prototypage collaboratif :** Des échantillons réfléchis élaborés ensemble.
* **Itération agile :** Tester, affiner et lancer rapidement.
* **Exécution évolutive :** Des essais au déploiement à l'échelle nationale, le tout sous un même toit.

##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.

### Zéro déchet à la décharge

Privacy Policy
At Johnvince Foods and its affiliated entities (hereinafter referred to as “Johnvince Foods”, “we” or “us”), we are committed to upholding privacy principles and complying with relevant privacy legislation regarding personal information. This Privacy Policy aims to explain to our valued customers and other individuals how we gather, utilize, disclose, and safeguard their personal information. Personal information, as defined by applicable privacy legislation, pertains to details about an identifiable individual.
This Privacy Policy is applicable to our practices concerning the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information in Canada and other applicable jurisdictions. It is also subject to the European Union’sGeneral Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) when applicable.
Please note that this Privacy Policy excludes information concerning current, former, or prospective employees (refer to our Employee PrivacyNotice), as well as data that does not qualify as personal information.
### Collection of Personal Information
In the course of its operations, Johnvince Foods, along with its agent sand representatives, gathers personal information in various instances. It’s important to note that, due to the potential lack of encryption in the online submission of information, we cannot guarantee the absolute privacy of data submitted through our website. The categories of personal information we collect encompass:
* Contact Information: Details such as your name, address, email address, and telephone number.
* Website Interaction: Information provided during registration or other interactions on our website.
* Surveys and Questionnaires: Data submitted when you participate in surveys or questionnaires.
* Promotions and Contests: Information provided in the context of promotions or contests.
* Other Modes of Submission: Details offered through alternative channels, such as telephone, mail, or our website.
* Customer Interactions: Records of customer calls, product-related comments, or inquiries.
* Additional Information: Any other information collected with your explicit consent or as permitted/required by law.
### Utilization of Personal Information
We use personal information for various purposes, including:
* Responding to Requests: Receiving and addressing your requests, inquiries, and comments.
* Marketing and Communication: With your consent, sending information about our products and promotions, conducting telephone surveys, and market research.
* Coupon Distribution: Periodically sending coupons with your consent.
* Customer Service: Providing exceptional customer service.
* Promotions and Contests: Administering promotions and contests.
* Database Creation: Establishing a database of individuals registered to receive information from us.
* Personalization: Understanding your preferences, needs, and interests to offer products and information tailored to you.
* Product Improvement: Enhancing and improving our products.
* Business Management: Managing our business and business records, including customer relations.
* Security Measures: Ensuring the security of our business operations, including our website. Account Management: Managing, administering, collecting, or enforcing accounts.
* Record Keeping:Maintaining business records as required by law and for reasonable periods.
* Legal Compliance: Meeting legal, regulatory, insurance, security, accounting, and processing requirements.
* Consent: Acting in accordance with purposes disclosed at the time of personal information collection.
* Other Legitimate Purposes: Otherwise, with consent or as permitted or required by law.
We collect personal information for commercial purposes, including:
1. Establishing and maintaining responsible commercial relations.
2. Understanding customer needs, trends, and preferences.
3. Evaluating, developing, enhancing, marketing, or providing product sand services.
4. Managing and developing business operations.
5. Meeting legal and regulatory requirements.
6. Protecting against error and fraud.

Disclosure of Personal Information
Johnvince Foods may disclose personal information in various circumstances, including to:
1. Persons seeking information as agents.
2. Companies or individuals performing functions on our behalf.
3. Companies or individuals aiding individuals explicitly entitled to the information.
4. Entities contributing to the evaluation, development, enhancement, marketing, or provision of our products or services.

Johnvince Foods may disclose personal information to its affiliates and business partners with your consent. This facilitates occasional communication about their products and services. Additionally, personal information may be shared with affiliates in other jurisdictions for internal audit, management, billing, administrative, and general business purposes.
### Retention of Personal Information
We have internal retention policies and procedures that build upon the following criteria to determine the retention periods of personal information in the context of the above-mentioned purposes:
* Time elapsed since your last interaction with the Johnvince Foods website
* End of the contractual relationship with a supplier or a third-party provider of products or services
* End of a recall period for a product or of a warranty on products or services
* Sensitivity of the personal information
* Security considerations

* On-going or potential litigation or dispute; and
* Regulatory or legal obligation to retain the personal information
### Service Providers
We may transfer personal information to external agents or service providers, including affiliates, who perform various services on our behalf. These services may include data processing, mailing, call center operations, billing, marketing, information technology, or data hosting. Some of these service providers or affiliates may operate in different jurisdictions. ### Business Transactions
Personal information may be utilized and disclosed in connection with proposed or actual financing, securitization, insuring, sale, assignment, or other disposal of all or part of Johnvince Foods or our business/assets. This disclosure serves purposes such as evaluating and performing the proposed transaction, meeting reporting or audit requirements, and allowing assignees or successors to use and disclose personal information for similar purposes.
### Legal, Regulatory, etc.
We may disclose personal information when necessary to meet legal, regulatory, industry self-regulatory, insurance, audit, and security requirements. Such disclosures may also occur with your consent or as permitted or required by law, including applicable Canadian and foreign laws governing Johnvince Foods, our agents, and/or service providers.
### Cookies Policy and Website Information Collection
Active Information Collection: Johnvince Foods website actively collects information through specific questions, email communication, and feedback forms. The collection, use, and disclosure of actively collected information have been outlined.
Passive Information Collection: Anonymous information is passively collected as you navigate through the website, using technologies such as cookies, Internet tags, web beacons, and navigational data collection. This includes details like the URL of the previous website, IP address, time and date of visit, pages visited, and browser information. The website may also use cookies for improved service, customization, statistics, and trend analysis. Passive information is not combined with personal information unless consent is provided.
### Cookies
Cookies are files of information that your web browser places on your computer or mobile phone when you visit a website. Cookies enable the website to remember your actions and preferences and recognize you when you return, so that we may analyze trends, determine your areas of interest, administer our website, and to remember your preferences (for example, your choice of language) in order to speed up the navigation process and to make your site experience more efficient.

Our Commitment
Snacking with purpose
We believe great food should also do good. That’s why we embed sustainability, community care, and people-first principles into every decision we make. Our impact goes beyond the shelf — it touches our environment, our people, and our global communities.
### Good
Food

### Community Impact
We support communities across Canada and the U.S. through initiatives that enrich lives, strengthen neighbourhoods, and create meaningful impact.
We’re committed to reducing waste, optimizing packaging, and sourcing responsibly to protect the planet for future generations.
Our Progress in Numbers
Impact you can measure
We believe in transparency. Here’s a snapshot of where we’re making a difference.
### 100% Waste Diverted
From Landfill
Every pound of waste generated across our facilities is recycled, repurposed, or converted to energy — none goes to landfill.
### 7.3 Million kWh of
Clean Energy Generated

Our ESG journey
### Zero Waste to Landfill
At our main plant, Johnvince Foods diverts 100% of waste away from landfills through recycling, repurposing, and energy recovery programs.

With 50,000 sq. ft. of solar panels across our facilities, Johnvince Foods has generated over 7.3 million kWh of clean energy since installation, reducing our reliance on non-renewable sources.

Home / **Our History**
From one roasting
pot to a snacking
powerhouse.
For over 50 years, Johnvince Foods has grown from a
family kitchen in Toronto to a leading North American snacking partner.
Our story is one of legacy, innovation, and bold growth
— always rooted in trust and quality.
How it all began
Roots of
resilience
In the early 1970s, Vincenzo and Irma Pulla began roasting nuts at home with one simple goal: to share high-quality snacks with families of every size, offering the freedom to choose just the right amount for life’s shared moments. Their passion quickly turned into something bigger — the launch of Johnvince Foods in 1973, introducing Canadians to the bulk food concept for the very first time.
A Legacy of Firsts
Breaking new ground in every decade
From the start, Johnvince Foods has been an industry pioneer. We didn’t just sell snacks — we changed how people experienced them. From opening one of Canada’s first bulk store to becoming the exclusive steward of PLANTERS® in Canada, every chapter of our story has been about anticipating change and shaping the future.
### Johnvince Foods founded in Toronto.
Johnvince was founded with strong heritage in conventional nuts, dried fruits, and mixes.
Introduced the bulk food concept to Canadian consumers.
Expansion into retail and wholesale distribution.
Secured exclusive Canadian rights to the PLANTERS® Brand.
Expanded operations with a flagship facility in Downsview, ON.
Partnered with TorQuest to fuel strategic growth.
Acquired David Roberts Foods, Durham-Ellis Pecan, and Hines Nut Company, extending reach into foodservice and the U.S. market.
Rolled out our new Johnvince brand identity and continued advancing our operations, marking another year of steady evolution and growth.
Growth With Purpose
From Canadian roots to North American reach
Today, Johnvince Foods employs more than 2,000 people across Canada and the United States. We’re proud to remain family-founded while scaling to become one of the most influential players in the snacking industry. Our commitment has never changed: to exceed customer cravings with quality, trust, and a relentless drive to innovate.
Legacy Meets Future
Honouring yesterday. Building tomorrow.
Our story is far from finished. With a clear vision, a growing house of brands, and a strategy built for the future, we are writing our next chapter. One that balances growth with sustainable impact. For us, legacy isn’t about looking back. It’s about building forward with the same values that started it all.
Know our impact →

##### Our History
Johnvince Foods is an established leader in innovating, manufacturing and distributing quality bulk foods across North America. We continue to invest in state of the art processing and packaging machinery to transform raw materials into finished goods for the bulk food and packaged goods trades. In the mid 90's Johnvince Foods purchased the comprehensive right to the Planters brand for Canada from Hershey's Canada. Presently, all major grocery retailers in Canada, purchase the vast majority of their bulk food requirements from Johnvince Foods.
Our valued customers include major & independent grocers, department chains in mass, drug, retail, club, & convenience channels as well as bulk retailers and wholesale distributors.
